name: Ontology Registry CLI Scenario Hardening Before REST
description: Before opening registry-service REST activation or a remote activation service, harden the local CLI proof for the completed ontology registry lifecycle across known packs, evidence persistence, registry consumption, rerun behavior, and operator failure interpretation.

userStories.title: Close The Completed Local Lifecycle State
userStories.description: As an ontology maintainer, I want the roadmap to distinguish completed local CLI lifecycle work from future REST/remote work so the next PRD does not reopen completed phases.
acceptanceCriteria: Confirm the allocation lifecycle remains closed through Phase 5 plus activation CLI and activation evidence persistence.
Confirm `tasks/prd-ontology-registry-allocation-lifecycle-master.md` marks activation evidence persistence as completed.
Confirm this PRD is listed as the next pre-REST public/local follow-up.
Confirm `authorization-ontology-system.spec.md` no longer treats activation evidence persistence as pending.
Confirm REST activation endpoint, remote activation service, scoped prefix support, and production registry persistence remain out of scope.
Do not change runtime code in this story unless a doc reference points at a missing or renamed source.
Manual build validation runs dependency builds before dependent builds and does not run `operational-ontology build` concurrently with `registry-service build`.
userStories.notes: US-001 doc closeout confirmed the lifecycle remains closed through Phase 5, activation CLI, and activation evidence persistence; the lifecycle master marks evidence persistence completed and, after US-007, marks CLI scenario hardening as completed pre-REST public/local evidence; authorization ontology system spec no longer treats evidence persistence as pending; REST activation endpoint, remote activation service, scoped prefix support, production registry persistence, new registry-service tables, and activation rollback semantics remain out of scope. No runtime code changed.

userStories.title: Add A CLI Scenario Matrix To The Specs
userStories.description: As a workflow reviewer, I want the CLI scenario matrix documented so pack activation proof is evaluated consistently before REST design begins.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a scenario matrix to `operational-ontology-registry-activation-cli.spec.md` or an adjacent spec section owned by that CLI surface.

Matrix columns include activation success, sidecar-only output, activation evidence append, registry validate/list, artifact extraction registry hit, duplicate same-store failure, rerun/upsert same evidence identity, output write failure, registry append failure, unknown pack, invalid flag, and invalid address model.
Each implemented row links to a concrete test title or source reference.
Any uncovered row is explicitly marked as a gap and assigned to a later story in this PRD.
Matrix must not imply REST, remote service, scoped prefix, or rollback support.
Manual build validation runs dependency builds before dependent builds and does not run `operational-ontology build` concurrently with `registry-service build`.
userStories.notes: Added docs/specs/operational-ontology/operational-ontology-registry-activation-cli-scenario-matrix.spec.md as the adjacent activation CLI validation matrix. The matrix covers programming-artifact-ontology, authorization-ontology, and CLI guardrail rows across all required columns; implemented cells cite concrete packages/cli/src/commands/ontology.test.ts test titles; authorization evidence gaps are assigned to US-004, pack-independent failure interpretation gaps to US-006, and cross-pack coexistence to US-005. The matrix is explicitly local CLI only and does not imply REST, remote service, scoped prefix, idempotency, or rollback support. Also corrected the CLI failure contract to the implemented invalid-cli-flag code. Required test/typecheck/build/def validate gates passed, with builds run in dependency order before registry-service.

userStories.title: Harden Programming Artifact Pack Evidence Replay
userStories.description: As a CLI automation user, I want `programming-artifact-ontology` activation evidence to be replayable and inspectable so the local CLI proof can support future API design.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify `programming-artifact-ontology --output <file>` remains sidecar-only and does not create or mutate an artifact registry.
Verify `programming-artifact-ontology --output <file> --artifact-registry <registry> --json` writes the sidecar before appending evidence.
Verify the registry validates and lists exactly one `activation-evidence` record for the command.
Verify successful rerun with the same pack/ontology/output identity upserts instead of duplicating evidence.
Verify duplicate/failed activation against the same store does not replace prior successful evidence.
Document the exact command sequence in `operational-ontology-registry-activation-cli.spec.md`.
Manual build validation runs dependency builds before dependent builds and does not run `operational-ontology build` concurrently with `registry-service build`.
userStories.notes: Tightened CLI sidecar-only coverage so `programming-artifact-ontology --output <file>` proves no registry file is created and an unrelated existing registry file is not mutated. Confirmed existing activation evidence replay tests cover sidecar-first append, registry validate/list with exactly one activation-evidence record, extract-artifact artifact-registry-hit resolution, same identity upsert on successful rerun, and failed duplicate non-replacement. Added the exact local replay command sequence and expected observations to operational-ontology-registry-activation-cli.spec.md. Required test/typecheck/build/def validate gates passed, with dependency builds run before registry-service build.

userStories.title: Add Authorization Pack Evidence Persistence Proof
userStories.description: As an authorization ontology maintainer, I want `authorization-ontology` to use the same activation evidence path as programming artifacts so both primary packs prove the lifecycle consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or confirm a CLI test invoking `ontology registry activate-pack authorization-ontology --output <file> --artifact-registry <registry> --json`.
Test uses an isolated SQLite activation store, sidecar output, and artifact registry JSON file.
Output includes all expected authorization taxonomy allocation summaries.
Registry contains an `activation-evidence` record whose id is deterministic for `authorization-ontology`.
Evidence metadata summarizes authorization namespace, allocation count, sync statuses, smoke summary, warnings, and errors.
Registry validate/list accepts the authorization activation evidence.
Duplicate same-store authorization activation does not append or replace successful evidence.
Update `authorization-ontology-system.spec.md` with the completed evidence proof when implemented.
Manual build validation runs dependency builds before dependent builds and does not run `operational-ontology build` concurrently with `registry-service build`.
userStories.notes: Added packages/cli/src/commands/ontology.test.ts coverage for authorization-ontology --output <file> --artifact-registry <registry> --json using isolated sidecar-only, first append, rerun, and duplicate activation stores. The scenario proves successful authorization activation, all eight taxonomy summaries, deterministic activation-evidence-authorization-ontology-authorization-ontology identity, authorization metadata summary, registry validate/list acceptance, extract-artifact artifact-registry-hit resolution, successful rerun upsert, and failed duplicate non-replacement. Updated authorization-ontology-system.spec.md, operational-ontology-registry-activation-cli.spec.md, and the scenario matrix to record the completed authorization evidence proof. Required test/typecheck/build/def validate gates passed, with dependency builds run before registry-service build.

userStories.title: Prove Cross-Pack Registry Coexistence
userStories.description: As an operator, I want one local programming artifact registry to hold activation evidence for multiple ontology packs so pack proofs do not collide.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a CLI scenario using one artifact registry file and separate isolated activation stores for `programming-artifact-ontology` and `authorization-ontology`.
Both successful activations append/upsert distinct `activation-evidence` records.
`ontology artifact registry list --kind activation-evidence --json` returns both records.
`ontology artifact registry validate --input <registry> --json` accepts the combined registry.
`extract-artifact` resolves each sidecar path to the correct pack evidence record.
Record ids, `producedByRef`, `derivedFromRefs`, `verifiesRefs`, and metadata remain pack-specific.
Re-running one pack does not mutate or duplicate the other pack's record.
Manual build validation runs dependency builds before dependent builds and does not run `operational-ontology build` concurrently with `registry-service build`.
userStories.notes: Added packages/cli/src/commands/ontology.test.ts coverage for one shared programming artifact registry populated by successful programming-artifact-ontology and authorization-ontology activations from separate SQLite stores and separate sidecar paths. The scenario proves two distinct activation-evidence records, combined registry validate/list acceptance, per-sidecar extract-artifact artifact-registry-hit resolution, pack-specific ids/provenance/derivedFromRefs/verifiesRefs/metadata, and programming rerun upsert without mutating or duplicating the authorization record. Updated operational-ontology-registry-activation-cli.spec.md and the scenario matrix to record the completed cross-pack coexistence proof. Required test/typecheck/build/def validate gates passed, with operational-ontology build completed before registry-service build.

userStories.title: Document Operator Failure Interpretation
userStories.description: As an operator, I want CLI failures to have stable interpretation before REST error mapping is designed.
acceptanceCriteria: Document the current no-rollback policy and structured failed activation result policy in the CLI spec.
Document command-level failures separately from helper lifecycle failures.
Document that registry append failure makes the command fail while preserving the successful activation sidecar.
Document that duplicate same-store activation is a structured helper failure, not a successful idempotent activation.
Document that REST idempotency and remote store ownership are intentionally undecided.
Verify existing tests or add missing tests for sidecar preservation, append failure sanitization, and no failed-evidence append.
Manual build validation runs dependency builds before dependent builds and does not run `operational-ontology build` concurrently with `registry-service build`.
userStories.notes: Updated operational-ontology-registry-activation-cli.spec.md with an explicit operator interpretation block separating CLI-owned command failures from helper lifecycle failures. Documented the local no-rollback policy, structured failed activation result policy, append-failure sidecar preservation, duplicate same-store activation as structured helper failure rather than successful idempotency, and intentionally undecided REST idempotency/remote store ownership. Added packages/cli/src/commands/ontology.test.ts authorization failure-mode coverage for output write failure, sanitized registry append failure, successful sidecar preservation, and no failed-evidence append; updated the scenario matrix so no US-006 local CLI gaps remain.
